description:
A node_exporter-style Grafana dashboard for mactop — a Prometheus exporter for Apple Silicon Macs.

https://github.com/pgodlews/mactop_exporter

panels.description: Apple Silicon Mac — chip model, P/S/E core counts, GPU cores. Sourced from mactop_system_info labels.
panels.title: System

panels.description: Total CPU utilisation across all core clusters.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Performance cluster — 12 high-clock cores.
panels.title: P-Cores

panels.description: Super cluster — 6 mid-tier cores (M5 Pro/Max only, shows 0 on other chips).
panels.title: S-Cores

panels.description: Current utilisation of each CPU core. Sorted descending.
panels.title: Per-Core Utilisation

panels.description: CPU total, P-core, and S-core utilisation over time.
panels.title: CPU Cluster Trends

panels.description: Hottest P-core and S-core sensor readings. Threshold at 85 °C (throttle risk) and 95 °C (critical).
panels.title: CPU Temperature

panels.description: CPU cluster power draw in watts. Correlate with temperature for throttling diagnosis.
panels.title: CPU Power

panels.description: Integrated GPU utilisation. 40 cores on M5 Max.
panels.title: GPU

panels.description: Current GPU operating frequency.
panels.title: GPU Frequency

panels.description: GPU die temperature.
panels.title: GPU Temp

panels.description: GPU cluster power draw.
panels.title: GPU Power

panels.description: GPU utilisation and frequency over time.
panels.title: GPU Trends

panels.description:
RAM used in GB out of total unified memory. Apple Silicon CPU, GPU and ANE share this pool.

⚠️ Memory breakdown (app/wired/cached) not available from mactop — only total used is exposed.
panels.title: Memory Used

panels.description: RAM utilisation as % of total unified memory.
panels.title: RAM %

panels.description:
Swap used / total. Apple Silicon writes swap to internal NVMe — high swap causes latency and SSD wear.

⚠️ Swap rate and compressed memory not available from mactop.
panels.title: Swap

panels.description: Unified memory bus bandwidth. CPU, GPU and ANE all share this. M5 Max peak: 400 GB/s.
panels.title: DRAM Bandwidth

panels.description: RAM and swap usage over time.
panels.title: Memory Over Time

panels.description: Total system power vs M5 Max TDP (92 W). Gauge fills as load increases.
panels.title: Total Power

panels.description: Current power draw broken down by subsystem. CPU and system dominate under load; ANE activates during ML inference.
panels.title: Power by Component

panels.description: Absolute total system power draw.
panels.title: Total Watts

panels.description: All power components over time. Total is the headline; System includes everything not counted separately.
panels.title: Power Trends

panels.description: One row per power rail, colour = watts. Darker = more power draw.
panels.title: Power Rails — Component Intensity Over Time

panels.description: All power rails bucketed into 2 W bands. Darker = more rails drawing at that level. Spikes show system power events.
panels.title: Power Distribution — Watt Band Density Over Time

panels.description: Top temperature sensors sorted by current reading. VRM readings above 80 °C indicate high power delivery. CPU P-Cores are the primary thermal constraint.

targets.expr: sort_desc(mactop_temp_sensor_celsius{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",name=~"(CPU P-Core 06|CPU P-Core 16|CPU P-Core 0A|CPU P-Core 1A|CPU Die Mb|CPU Die DX|CPU Core HP|VRM MX|VRM mS|VRM D0|VRM DA|VRM DG|VRM DM|VRM DP|GPU DX|SoC Package DX|Memory VR|NVMe.*|Ambient OL)"})

panels.title: Hot Zones — Top Sensors

panels.description: Key sensor temperatures over time. Threshold lines at 75 °C and 90 °C.
panels.title: Thermal Trends

panels.description: Fan speed in RPM. MacBook Air: 0 RPM is correct — passively cooled. Fan blades on the design indicate fans.
panels.title: Fans

panels.description: Every temp sensor bucketed into 5°C bands. Darker = more sensors in that range.
panels.title: Thermal Distribution — All Sensors Over Time

panels.description: All temperature sensors sorted hottest-first. LCD colour indicates severity.
panels.title: Sensor Heat Map — Top 60 Sensors (current)

panels.description:
Disk read/write throughput (KB/s → auto-scales). mactop_disk_kbytes_per_sec is correctly in KB/s.

⚠️ Disk model, queue depth not available from mactop.
panels.title: Disk I/O

panels.description: I/O operations per second.
panels.title: Disk IOPS

panels.description:
Network throughput in bytes/sec (all interfaces).

⚠️ Bug in mactop: mactop_network_kbytes_per_sec is actually in bytes/sec despite the metric name. This dashboard uses Bps unit accordingly.

⚠️ Per-interface stats (en0, Wi-Fi) and daily totals not available from mactop.
panels.title: Network

panels.description: Unified system timeline: CPU utilisation (blue), GPU utilisation (green), and total power (amber). Correlate spikes across all three for workload analysis. This is the 'story of the machine' panel.
panels.title: Last Hour — CPU · GPU · Power
